# ff-ruyijs

> Run any site's JavaScript from Python — with the real Firefox engine.

ff-ruyijs is a headless Firefox engine for Python. It embeds the genuine SpiderMonkey (Firefox 160) JavaScript engine and the Necko HTTP/1.1·2·3 networking stack in an isolated process, so Python code can execute a site's scripts, pass bot checks, and collect data — without a browser window, without a renderer, and without detection.

## Install

```
pip install ruyijs
```

Requires Python 3.10+ on Windows x64, macOS arm64 (macOS 26+) or Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.39+). Each wheel bundles its native runtime.

## Quick example

```python
from ruyijs import Context

with Context() as ctx:
    ctx.eval("let x = 40")
    print(ctx.eval("x + 2"))           # 42
    print(ctx.eval("navigator.userAgent"))
```

## Core API

- Context(proxy=, timeout=) — create an isolated browser process
- ctx.eval(src) — execute JS, return result
- ctx.load_page(url, html) — load HTML with scripts and iframes
- ctx.navigate(url) — top-level navigation
- ctx.configure_fingerprint({navigator, screen, viewport, locale}) — set browser profile
- ctx.configure_clock("logical"|"system") — deterministic or real time
- ctx.advance(ms) — drive the event loop
- ctx.set(name, value) — inject data into JS
- ctx.expose(fn, name) — expose Python function to JS
- ctx.put_resource(url, body) — serve responses offline
- ctx.console_log() / ctx.net_log() — captured console and network records
- JSError — JS exception (name, message, stack)
- JSObject / JSFunction — live JS handles callable from Python

## Verification systems it defeats

Ruishu 5/6, Geetest, Tencent Captcha, Shumei, NetEase Yidun, Arkose Labs, Akamai Bot Manager 3.x, Alibaba 234/fireyejs, CreepJS (all sections).
